BiblicalUsage: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver, and the word for fitly is this one: a word in its right season, in its right circumstance, at the right time.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe timing is part of truth: the right word at the wrong time is not fit, and wisdom is knowing the season as well as the sentence.
